scope: Active installed dependency closure of mcp==2.2.0 for the recorded verification environment, with all identified installed runtime distribution license/notice files copied byte-for-byte. Libraries themselves are installed separately and are not vendored.
method: Read importlib.metadata distributions, evaluate Requires-Dist environment markers and requested extras recursively, retain package-declared license metadata and upstream project URLs, copy installed license/notice files, compute SHA-256, and verify each copied file against its installed RECORD SHA-256 when available. No local absolute paths, user profiles, keys or application data are recorded.
limitations: This is a versioned installation snapshot, not a lockfile; a later installation or another Python/platform environment may resolve different transitive dependencies.
License metadata can omit component-specific terms. Read copied notices, especially the multiple-license pywin32 distribution.
This is not a full recursive native/binary dependency audit, legal clearance, copyright immunity claim, or formal clean-room certification.
The separately installed Python interpreter and standard library are not vendored or inventoried as package dependencies.

Build/installer tools below are excluded from the application runtime closure and their library code and notices are not copied. Isolated build requirements not installed in this environment are declared separately.
